scope: FULL, configured 200 Hz, continuous USB read, voltage only

definitions.raw_historical_including_known_fault: All supplied continuous-read records, including additions, original fault condition, and separate repaired M0 record.
definitions.no_reported_supply_contact_fault: Point-level filter: only the affected original M0 voltage is excluded. SOURCE/M1/M2 are user-confirmed unaffected and retained. This does not establish verified fault-free operation.
definitions.complete_voltage_record: Same record contains main/MIN/MAX source voltage and main/MIN/MAX voltage for every connected module.
definitions.accepted_complete_voltage_record: A complete raw voltage record whose voltage points have no reported supply-contact fault.
definitions.accepted_configuration_coverage: Configuration has accepted source and all module main/MIN/MAX readings, either in one record or via the explicitly user-confirmed pointwise correction. Coverage counts configurations, not new runs or independent repeats.
definitions.same_record_coverage: Accepted complete records remain separately counted; original M0 fault plus partial retest does not become a same-record acquisition.
definitions.main_reading: Existing avg fields retained as main/representative readings; not verified time averages.
definitions.recorded_min: Meter MIN field, not a statistical lower confidence bound or an independently repeated run.
definitions.drop: Raw module_voltages.csv uses decimal (source main - module main) * 1000 from the same record only; sequential readings are not guaranteed simultaneous. The raw M0 retest has no source or drop.
definitions.corrected_drop: accepted_configuration_voltage.csv permits the explicit user-confirmed unchanged source minus retested M0 estimate (35 mV), flagged as not same-record. It is excluded from same-record drop summaries.
definitions.numeric_encoding: Voltage and voltage-drop quantities are exact decimal strings; CSV blank and JSON null mean unavailable.
definitions.repair: M0-only measurement after connector repair. Its voltage replaces only the faulty M0 point in the accepted configuration; original SOURCE/M1/M2 are retained under user confirmation. No new full acquisition or independent repeat is created.

quality_event.evidence_basis: User clarification: 供电线或供电接头接触不良
quality_event.clarification_basis: User: 其他测点并未接触不良，还是原来的电压。M0是因为connector接触不良
quality_event.interpretation: Retain as an actual supply-connection fault condition; do not describe it as a voltmeter/probe measurement error.
quality_event.normal_connection_analysis_action: Exclude only the original M0 voltage point. Retain SOURCE/M1/M2 voltages confirmed unchanged by the user; use the separate 3.241 V M0 retest in a pointwise-corrected configuration with per-point provenance.
quality_event.other_fields_action: SOURCE/M1/M2 voltages are explicitly confirmed unaffected and remain valid. Original current and temperature values remain unchanged; the clarification does not supply new current or temperature measurements and does not authorize blanket exclusion of the whole run.
quality_event.replacement_scope: M0 voltage only. Retain the other voltage points under explicit user confirmation; do not claim a new simultaneous acquisition.
quality_event.corrected_drop_basis: Retained source 3.276 V minus retested M0 3.241 V gives 35 mV; a user-confirmed pointwise estimate, not a same-record or simultaneous new measurement.
report_2_1_implications: 3.224 V and 89 mV describe a contact-fault condition, not the normal-connection minimum.
Only the original M0 voltage point and its 52 mV difference carry the connector-fault label. SOURCE/M1/M2 voltages remain accepted; do not infer that the entire configuration is invalid.
ZERO voltage configuration coverage is complete using the user-confirmed pointwise correction, with explicit source provenance and no extra independent repeat.
Do not claim fault-free operation; default zero counters do not override this known contact fault.
